content: We have carbon NMR shifts: list includes 8 carbons. Need number of CH3 groups (methyl). Methyl carbons typically around 10-30 ppm for aliphatic, but here we have 43.47 and 38.60 (likely CH2 or CH3 attached to aromatic). The aromatic carbons are around 130-138 ppm. So methyl groups likely correspond to the aliphatic carbons. Need to determine if both are methyls or one is methylene. Could use proton NMR to see number of methyl signals. Let's get proton NMR.
